notes.TWN: Passport Index 把台灣護照前往中國大陸列為免簽證，實際上台灣居民前往中國大陸用的是台胞證（臺灣居民來往大陸通行證），不用護照，所以改列為「另用通行證」，不算進護照實力；中國大陸居民來台用的是往來台灣通行證與入出境許可證，也一樣改列。香港（免簽證 30 天）、澳門（免簽證）照資料集，前往香港要先網上預辦入境登記；兩岸與港澳事務由陸委會主管。側欄另外跟外交部領事事務局的名單逐國比對。
notes.CHN: 兩岸與港澳之間用通行證或許可入境、不用護照，Passport Index 原本的分類（免簽證或需要簽證）改列為「另用通行證」，也不算進護照實力與開放程度。

notesEn.TWN: Passport Index lists mainland China as visa-free for the Taiwan passport, but Taiwan residents travel there on the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents rather than a passport, so it is shown as "travel permit" and not counted towards passport power; mainland residents visiting Taiwan likewise use travel permits and entry permits. Hong Kong (visa-free, 30 days) and Macao (visa-free) follow the dataset; Hong Kong requires online pre-arrival registration. Cross-strait and Hong Kong/Macao matters fall under the Mainland Affairs Council. The side panel compares every destination with the Bureau of Consular Affairs list.
notesEn.CHN: Travel between mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao uses dedicated travel permits rather than passports, so the Passport Index category (visa-free or visa required) is shown as "travel permit" instead and not counted towards passport power or openness.
